0022600172.text: The Heat are 2-4 this season, sitting 10th in the East and one game back of first in the Southeast, and they are on a two-game winning streak in their 7th game of the season. The Lakers are 4-1, first in the Pacific and third in the West, with a one-game winning streak and another game still to play before this one. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Heat lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 134-126 in Miami on March 19, 2026.
